ns2:section.sectionText: Topics: Approximation Algorithms. Approximation algorithms for NP-hard problems are polynomial time heuristics that have provable guarantees on the quality of their solutions. This course will provide a broad introduction to results and techniques in this area. Emphasis will be on fundamental problems and techniques that are of wide applicability. In particular, this terms class will focus mostly on linear and semi-definite programming methods for graph problems.
